scope: Two runs on a frozen Debug build of 5044285e (artifacts/oi1, git archive), each on one fresh owned PLCSIM Advanced V8 CPU 1511 instance on Softbus of an owned scratch CPU 1511-1 PN V4.1, released afterwards. Members of a structured output tag (1 November audit fix): scripts/qualify_plcsim_signals.py, 95/95 steps (run ps_95b2f7f7), repeats every check of local.sim.output-refusal.20261101 and adds SigOutStruct, a PLC tag of the PLC data type SigOutUdt (members A and B, Int) at %Q24.0 imported with tag_table_import_xml, whose members the program writes every scan; PLCSIM's tag list reports SigOutStruct (Struct), SigOutStruct.A and SigOutStruct.B all in the area Output. sim_write of "SigOutStruct".A, and a sim_write_signals batch of SigMarker and "SigOutStruct".A, refused with InvalidRequest, details.symbol "SigOutStruct".A and details.area Output; QB24..27 read the same before and after and SigMarker stayed 4321. diagnostic_plcsim_write: scripts/qualify_plcsim_diagnostics.py, 60/60 steps (run ps_6b3362fe), runs the checks of local.plcsim_diagnostics.20261028 (Enable of one FB instance) and adds a second diagnostic_plan case over the PLC tags DiagIn (%I30.0), DiagMarker (%M30.0) and DiagOut (%Q30.0; the program copies DiagIn to it), all resolved as captured Bool declarations; PLCSIM reports their areas Input, Marker and Output. diagnostic_plcsim_write of DiagOut, and of DiagMarker with DiagOut, refused with InvalidRequest and every value read the same afterwards; a write of DiagIn and DiagMarker together returned written with two dispatches and matching readbacks, DiagOut followed DiagIn, and a second write reset both.
limitations: One owned PLCSIM Advanced V8 CPU 1511 instance per run on Softbus; output tags without a configured I/O module. Array elements of an output tag are not exercised (the fixture's structured output tag is a PLC data type).

The program writes the output tags every scan, so unchanged reads after a refusal show the refusal and the scan agree; a write that slipped through would be overwritten at the next scan. The Host reports diagnostic_plcsim_write refusals with its generic message, so only the code InvalidRequest is checked there.
Engineering scratch and simulation only; no physical PLC.
